jobs.title: SAP DRC PROGRAM MANAGER (FTE)
jobs.description:
SAP DRC PROGRAM MANAGER (FTE)
   

  

 Summary
   

 We are seeking a seasoned professional to lead strategic initiatives as an SAP DRC Program Manager within the IT Services sector. This pivotal role demands a visionary leader capable of orchestrating complex, large\-scale programs that integrate advanced financial technologies with robust project governance frameworks. The successful candidate will drive the adoption of SAP Business AI for Finance and ensure seamless delivery across diverse landscapes, including S/4HANA, ECC, and legacy systems. This position is critical for aligning technology execution with business objectives, managing cross\-functional teams, and maintaining strict adherence to finance, tax, and compliance regulations while navigating hybrid project delivery models.
   

  

 Responsibilities
   

* Direct the end\-to\-end lifecycle of SAP DRC programs, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory standards.
* Oversee the implementation and optimization of SAP BRIM and SAP Business AI for Finance solutions to enhance operational efficiency.
* Manage project governance structures, including risk identification, mitigation strategies, and performance monitoring across multiple workstreams.
* Facilitate hybrid project delivery methodologies, blending Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid approaches to suit specific program requirements.
* Ensure strict compliance with finance and tax regulations, leveraging expertise in SAP Tax \& Compliance Program Management.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to deliver integrated solutions across FICO, SD, MM, and other SAP modules.
* Monitor program risks and financial implications, providing actionable insights to senior leadership for strategic decision\-making.
* Drive the integration of SAP DRC capabilities within broader enterprise architectures, including S/4HANA and ECC environments.


 Requirements
   

  

**Requirements:**
* Minimum of 10\+ years of progressive experience in IT Services, specifically within SAP program and project management.
* Proven expertise in SAP BRIM, SAP Business AI for Finance, and comprehensive SAP DRC implementation.
* Deep proficiency in managing hybrid project delivery models, including Agile, Waterfall, and combined methodologies.
* Strong background in project governance, risk management, and financial compliance within the SAP ecosystem.
* Extensive knowledge of SAP modules including FICO, SD, MM, and specific experience with SAP Tax \& Compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large\-scale transformation programs involving S/4HANA and ECC migrations or integrations.
* Salary expectation aligned with market standards for this level of expertise, approximately ₹20 LPA.

jobs.title: SAP BRIM Consultant, Director
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 As a SAP BRIM Consultant, Director, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize their operational efficiency through specialized consulting services for SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) applications. You will analyze client requirements, implement CRM software solutions, and provide training and support to facilitate seamless integration and utilization of SAP CRM applications. Within our Advisory practice, you will enable clients to enhance customer relationship management processes and achieve their strategic objectives.
   

  

 As a Director, you will set the strategic direction and lead business development efforts, making impactful decisions while overseeing multiple projects. You will maintain executive\-level client relations, translating vision into actionable strategies and inspiring others to follow. Your role is crucial in driving business growth, shaping client engagements, and mentoring the next generation of leaders. You are expected to uphold PwC's reputation for quality, integrity, and inclusion, fostering an environment where people and technology thrive together. In this role, you will identify market gaps and convert opportunities into successes for the firm, promoting technological advances and creating a healthy working environment that maximizes client satisfaction.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leading strategic direction and business development efforts for SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) applications
* Analyzing client requirements to implement CRM software solutions that optimize customer relationship management processes
* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP CRM applications
* Driving business growth by identifying market gaps and converting opportunities into success for the firm
* Mentoring the next generation of leaders and fostering a collaborative environment across the PwC Network
* Promoting technological advances and creating environments where people and technology thrive together
* Developing new ideas, solutions, and structures to drive thought leadership and innovation
* Balancing long\-term, short\-term, detail\-oriented, and big picture thinking to make strategic choices and drive change
* Cultivating potential in others and maintaining executive\-level client relations to maximize client satisfaction


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 8 years of experience


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Preference for a Master's or Masters of Business Administration degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems
* Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Cloud for Customer and SAP CRM
* Utilizing strategic mindset for business process improvement
* Leading customer transformation initiatives with CRM software
* Excelling in business technology and systemic thinking
* Driving innovation through rapid experimentation and creativity
* Cultivating customer engagement and relationship management skills


 The salary range for this position is: $155,000 \- $410,000\. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits\-at\-a\-glance
   

  

 As PwC is an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at PwC without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity); age; disability; genetic information (including family medical history); veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or, any other status protected by law.
   

  

 PwC does not intend to hire experienced or entry level job seekers who will need, now or in the future, PwC sponsorship through the H\-1B lottery, except as set forth within the following policy: https://pwc.to/H\-1B\-Lottery\-Policy.

jobs.title: SAP FICO Public, Private Cloud- Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
 FICO – Sr. Consultant – L3
   

  

 Lead and deliver end\-to\-end SAP S/4HANA Finance implementations (Private and Public Cloud) for global clients. You will be responsible for solution design, configuration, integration, and deployment of core Finance processes, ensuring best practices and business value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and execute full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA FI implementations (Private \& Public Cloud).
* Own the end\-to\-end design and configuration of core finance modules: FI\-GL, FI\-AP, FI\-AR, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, and Cash Management.
* Integrate FI with other modules (CO, MM, SD, etc.).
* Architect and deliver robust integrations between S/4HANA Finance and external systems (e.g., payment gateways, banks, customer portals).
* Manage data migration, cutover, and post\-go\-live support.
* Conduct Fit\-to\-Standard and Delta Design workshops, balancing statutory, regulatory, and performance requirements.
* Establish KPI dashboards using Embedded Analytics, CDS views, and Fiori.
* Advise clients on SAP best practices, innovations, and digital transformation.
* Provide expertise in SAP Fiori apps, S/4HANA Data Migration tools, and cloud\-specific functionalities.
* Lead user training, UAT, and prepare project documentation.
* Collaborate with technical teams for enhancements, interfaces, and custom developments.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8 years of hands\-on SAP FI experience, with at least 2 to 3 end\-to\-end S/4HANA implementations in Private cloud and at least 1 end to end implementation in Public Cloud).
* Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Finance—FI\-AR, Credit Management, Collections \& Dispute, Cash Management, Bank Communication.
* Proven track record designing API\- and event\-driven integrations via SAP BTP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI), IDoc/AIF, OData \& SOAP services.
* Hands\-on experience with payment integrations (Direct Debit, SEPA, card tokenization, open\-banking APIs).
* Solid grasp of IFRS / local GAAP and public\-sector finance compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to tune system performance and lead large\-scale data migrations.
* Experience with SAP Activate methodology and Agile or hybrid delivery.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or related field.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SAP S/4HANA certification (FI or FICO).
* Experience with SAP Public Cloud and Private Cloud editions.
* Exposure to SAP BRIM, Subscription Billing, CPQ, or Revenue Accounting.
* Experience in Integration Monitoring and Exception Handling for public\-cloud landscapes.
* Strong client\-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead workshops and training sessions.
* Proactive, self\-driven, and adaptable to new technologies.


**Get empowered by NTT DATA Business Solutions!**
**We transform. SAP® solutions into Value**
**NTT DATA Business Solutions is a fast\-growing international IT company and one of the world’s leading SAP partners. We are a full service provider delivering everything from business consulting to implementation of SAP solutions, including hosting services and support.**

jobs.title: SAP - IS-U Billing -Senior - Consulting - Location OPEN
jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 EY helps utilities organizations transform their operations through innovative SAP solutions that improve efficiency, enhance customer experiences, and support regulatory compliance. We work with clients across the utility value chain, helping them navigate complex business and technology transformations from strategy through execution.
   

  

 As an SAP IS\-U Billing Senior Consultant, you will support the design, configuration, testing, and implementation of SAP IS\-U Billing and Invoicing solutions. You will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate utility billing requirements into effective functional solutions that support accurate, timely, and explainable customer bills across the meter\-to\-cash lifecycle.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will work with clients and internal teams to deliver SAP IS\-U Billing and Invoicing solutions. You will apply your functional knowledge, analytical skills, and utility industry experience to address complex billing requirements and support successful project delivery. This position may require regular travel to meet client needs. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Gathering and analyzing requirements for billing and invoicing across electric, gas, and/or water utilities, customer classes, and service territories.
* Supporting the functional design and configuration of SAP IS\-U Billing and Invoicing solutions, including billing\-relevant master data, rate structures, facts, operands, billing schemas, rates, billing orders, and billing controls.
* Configuring and supporting periodic and non\-periodic billing, estimates, rebilling, reversals, adjustments, budget billing, bill simulation, and exception resolution, as applicable.
* Configuring and validating invoicing, billing document creation, payment handoffs, bill\-output interfaces, and downstream financial postings with FI\-CA and related systems.
* Analyzing billing exceptions and processing results to identify root causes involving meter reads, device data, rates, customer data, contract data, or system integrations.
* Preparing functional designs, configuration documentation, test scenarios, process flows, and other project deliverables.
* Executing unit and integration testing and supporting user acceptance testing, regression testing, parallel billing, and defect resolution.
* Coordinating end\-to\-end process impacts and dependencies across Device Management, Energy Data Management, FI\-CA, Customer Service, Retail Choice, bill print, reporting, and technical integration teams.
* Supporting time\-of\-use, interval\-based, consumption\-based, and other complex billing scenarios based on client requirements.
* Supporting billing\-cycle readiness, reconciliation, cutover, production incidents, operational procedures, and post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Collaborating with client stakeholders, business users, technical teams, and project leadership to communicate issues, clarify requirements, and support timely solution decisions.
* Providing knowledge transfer and functional guidance to client teams and junior project team members.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 To thrive in this role, you will need a combination of SAP IS\-U functional knowledge, utility industry experience, and strong client\-service skills. Your ability to analyze complex billing requirements, collaborate across teams, and communicate clearly will be important to deliver successful outcomes.
   

  

* Strong functional knowledge of SAP IS\-U Billing and Invoicing and the broader utility meter\-to\-cash process.
* Hands\-on configuration experience with SAP IS\-U billing schemas, rates, billing master data, invoicing, and billing\-cycle processes.
* Understanding of utility rates, tariffs, billing cycles, billing exceptions, consumption\-based billing, and related financial impacts.
* Understanding of billing dependencies involving meter reading, device data, customer and contract data, Energy Data Management, and FI\-CA.
* Ability to translate business, regulatory, and operational requirements into practical SAP IS\-U functional designs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to investigate billing exceptions and identify root causes.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business, functional, technical, and integration teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain functional requirements and solution decisions to business and technology stakeholders.
* Ability to manage assigned deliverables, dependencies, risks, and priorities in a client\-service environment.


**To qualify for the role, you must have:**
* A bachelor’s degree.
* Typically, no less than 3 to 4 years of SAP IS\-U or SAP Utilities experience, including at least 3 years of hands\-on experience with SAP IS\-U Billing and Invoicing.
* Hands\-on experience delivering functional requirements, configuration or solution design, testing, and production support in a utility environment.
* Experience configuring SAP IS\-U billing schemas, rates, facts, operands, billing master data, billing orders, invoicing, and billing\-cycle processes.
* Experience supporting periodic and non\-periodic billing, rebilling, reversals, adjustments, billing exceptions, and bill simulation.
* Understanding of meter\-to\-cash processes and the dependencies among Billing, Device Management, Energy Data Management, FI\-CA, Customer Service, and connected systems.
* Experience preparing functional specifications, configuration documentation, test scenarios, process flows, and other project documentation.
* Experience executing unit and integration testi

jobs.title: Lead / Senior SAP Joule & Multi-Agent Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are building the next generation of enterprise AI interoperability. As an **SAP Joule \& Multi\-Agent Integration Engineer**, you will pioneer our agentic AI roadmap — designing, building, and securing cross\-platform agent networks that connect SAP's Joule ecosystem with ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms over open agent communication protocols. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development, from BTP provisioning through production A2A orchestration.

**Responsibilities**

* Architect and implement end\-to\-end A2A communication between SAP Joule and the ServiceNow platform — exposing Joule agents as A2A\-compliant servers via SAP Agent Gateway, authoring Agent Cards, configuring JSON\-RPC endpoints, and registering External Agent Providers in ServiceNow AI Agent Studio over Google A2A protocol v0\.3\.0
* Design primary/secondary agent delegation patterns, async push notification flows, and timeout\-resilient pipelines across SAP and non\-SAP agent networks — ensuring agents reason, delegate, and recover reliably at enterprise scale
* Configure end\-to\-end authentication across agent boundaries using OAuth2, SAP IAS App2App trust, and BTP Cloud Identity Services — enforcing least\-privilege access, token governance, and audit\-ready agent call chains
* Own the full SAP BTP stack underpinning agent workloads — AI Core provisioning, SAP Build Process Automation entitlements, Cloud Foundry runtime, Destination Service, and SAP Agent Gateway configuration
* Instrument agent pipelines with structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerting so failures are caught early, root\-caused quickly, and prevented systematically across multi\-hop agent calls

**Requirements**

* 4\+ years of hands\-on SAP BTP engineering experience, including Cloud Foundry, SAP Cloud Identity Services, and Destination Service configuration
* Proven experience building and deploying custom Joule agents in Joule Studio (pro\-code path) with tool definitions wired to SAP backend systems via OData or REST APIs
* Demonstrated production experience enabling Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) integration between SAP Joule and ServiceNow AI Agent Studio, including Agent Card authoring, External Agent Provider registration, credential aliasing, and A2A protocol handshake validation
* Strong command of agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent) and multi\-agent orchestration patterns, including delegation, fallback, and async response handling
* Solid understanding of API security and authentication: OAuth 2\.0, mutual TLS, SAP IAS trust configurations, and BTP service bindings
* Familiarity with ServiceNow platform internals — Now Assist AI Agents, Integration Hub, Flow Designer, and Connection \& Credential Aliases
* Strong grasp of distributed systems design, API performance, and fault\-tolerance patterns relevant to multi\-agent pipelines
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex agent topology designs for both engineering and business audiences

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) alongside A2A for tool and resource exposure across agent boundaries
* Exposure to SAP BRIM, SOM, or BTP Integration Suite (CPI) for SAP business process integration context
* Familiarity with ServiceNow Yokohama/Zurich release features for external agent interoperability

* CI/CD experience for BTP workloads using Cloud Foundry CLI, MTA deployment, or GitHub Actions pipelines

jobs.title: SAP ABAP Developer (RICEFW, HANA, BRIM/FSCM)
jobs.description:
Experienced SAP ABAP Developer with expertise in RICEFW, HANA, and SAP BRIM/FSCM, seeking to contribute to cross\-functional teams in a hybrid role based in Pune.
  
We are seeking an experienced SAP ABAP Developer to join our team. The role focuses on RICEFW development, HANA programming, and SAP BRIM/FSCM solutions. The candidate will work in a hybrid model based in Pune.


**Key responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain ABAP objects including reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, and workflows.
* Create and optimize HANA CDS, attribute, analytic, and native views, and develop AMDP/ADBC code.
* Implement and support SAP BRIM/FSCM functionalities, including BRF\+, CRM, SOM, Convergent Charging, and CPQ.
* Integrate SAP solutions with external systems using REST, SOAP, OData, and RFCs.
* Develop and enhance Fiori applications and SAP Gateway services.
* Participate in HANA migration, S/4HANA simplification, and performance tuning.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure solution quality and compliance with SAP best practices.

**Required qualifications**


* Minimum 8 years of SAP ABAP design and development experience.
* At least 8 years of hands‑on experience with RICEFW objects.
* 2\+ years of HANA development and CDS view creation.
* Proven experience with SAP BRIM/FSCM modules and related technologies.
* Strong knowledge of SAP CRM, Fiori, and API integration (REST, SOAP, OData).
* Ability to work 2‑3 days per week on‑site in Pune and overlap 4 hours with US business hours.

**Nice to have**


* Experience with SAP S/4HANA migration projects.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as SAP Cloud Platform.
* Certifications in SAP ABAP or SAP HANA.
* Prior exposure to agile methodologies.

* Hands\-on experience in Sales Order Management, pricing, contract management, invoicing, and credit/debit memo processes.

* Strong expertise in integration testing, UAT, defect management, and production support.
* Experience working with technical teams on enhancements, interfaces, APIs, and system integrations.
* Familiarity with SAP Fiori, S/4HANA business processes, and Agile delivery methodologies.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, problem\-solving, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
